title: Create a high-fashion studio portrait of
prompt: Create a high-fashion studio portrait of a young adult woman with delicate natural facial features, a cute subtle mixed-heritage look, soft face shape, dimensional features without an overly influencer-like appearance, and long voluminous layered black hair with slightly messy lazy flyaway strands; several loose strands fall naturally across her cheeks and forehead with realistic hair texture. She sits on a seamless warm off-white studio floor and backdrop, posed low on the ground with one leg bent high toward the camera, the other leg folded and extended diagonally, one hand supporting her behind her, shoulders slightly hunched inward, gazing directly at the camera with a calm, slightly sultry expression. Outfit: fitted black long-sleeve top with a low square neckline, black sparkling sequined mini skirt, sheer black stockings, and black ankle-strap stiletto sandals. Use soft diffused editorial lighting, realistic skin texture, muted neutral tones, shallow but not extreme depth of field, full-body vertical composition with generous negative space, magazine lookbook styling, no harsh shadows, no watermark. Add exactly 3 small minimalist typography blocks in tiny uppercase serif text: top left reads “I’M NOT / A REBEL, / I’M JUST NOT YOU.”; lower left beside a short horizontal line reads “BEAUTY IS / POWER; / A SMILE IS / ITS SWORD.”; right middle reads “TOO SOFT / FOR ALL OF IT.” with a thin vertical bracket mark. Keep the typography subtle, black, and very small against the blank background.
